advanced_stt.notice.no_key: No %s API key yet. Type /astt to add one.
advanced_stt.notice.time_limit: Microphone turned off after %s (you can change this in /astt).
advanced_stt.notice.internal_error: Dictation stopped because of an unexpected error. Details are in the game log.
advanced_stt.notice.not_sent.command: Commands are never sent automatically. Check it, then press Enter.
advanced_stt.notice.not_sent.too_long: Too long for one chat message (%s of %s characters). Shorten it, then press Enter.
advanced_stt.notice.not_sent.repeat: Same as your last message, so it was not sent again. Press Enter to send it.
advanced_stt.notice.not_sent.restricted: Chat messages can't be sent right now. See the chat box.
advanced_stt.error.invalid_key: %s refused the API key. Check it with /astt.
advanced_stt.error.no_credits: %s says your account has no credits left.
advanced_stt.error.rate_limited: %s is refusing new sessions for now (too many requests). Try again in a moment.
advanced_stt.error.network: Can't reach %s. Check your internet connection.
advanced_stt.error.audio_backlog: Your connection is too slow to send the audio, so dictation stopped.
advanced_stt.test.no_answer: %s closed the connection without accepting the key.
advanced_stt.settings.title: Advanced STT
advanced_stt.settings.key.hint_replace: Key saved. Paste a new one to replace it
advanced_stt.settings.key.test.tooltip: Opens a connection and closes it as soon as the service accepts the key. No audio is sent. AssemblyAI bills the second or so it stays open.
advanced_stt.settings.key.saved.windows: Key saved, encrypted for your Windows account.
advanced_stt.settings.key.saved.file: Key saved, encrypted in your user folder.
advanced_stt.settings.key.privacy: Your key stays on this computer, outside the game folder, so sharing your game folder or modpack never shares it. It is only sent to the service you chose, never to anyone else.
advanced_stt.settings.key.empty: Paste a key in the box first.
advanced_stt.settings.key.invalid: That doesn't look like an API key (spaces or odd characters).
advanced_stt.settings.key.saved_now: Saved. Use Test key to check it.
advanced_stt.settings.mode.balanced.tool: AssemblyAI's default: a middle ground between speed and accuracy. All three modes cost the same.
advanced_stt.settings.mode.min_latency.t: Your words show as soon as possible, but a short pause can end your sentence early. All three modes cost the same.
The most accurate. Waits a little longer before ending a sentence, so long sentences aren't cut. All three modes cost the same.
advanced_stt.settings.voice_focus.off.to: Voice Focus removes the noise around your voice (game sound, keyboard, fan) before AssemblyAI hears it. It costs $%s more per hour when it's on.
advanced_stt.settings.voice_focus.near_f: Removes the noise around your voice. For a headset or a microphone close to your mouth. Costs $%s more per hour.
advanced_stt.settings.voice_focus.far_fi: Removes the noise around your voice. For a laptop or desk microphone. Costs $%s more per hour.
advanced_stt.settings.activation.hold.to: Hold the talk key while you speak. Let go to stop.
Press the talk key once to start, and again to stop.
advanced_stt.settings.max_session.toolti: The microphone turns itself off after this long, so a forgotten microphone never keeps a paid connection open.
advanced_stt.settings.send.manual.info: Your words go in the chat box. Press Enter to send.
advanced_stt.settings.send.auto.info: Sent when you stop talking. Never commands.
advanced_stt.settings.silence.tooltip: How long to wait after you stop talking before the message is sent.
advanced_stt.settings.words.tooltip: Player names, place names and game words the service should spell right, separated by commas. Up to 100.
advanced_stt.settings.usage.no_balance: Type your balance below to see what's left
advanced_stt.settings.usage.note.cartesi: Estimated at %s credits per second of audio.
advanced_stt.settings.usage.note.assembl: Estimated at $%s per hour of connection.
advanced_stt.settings.usage.note.tooltip: The mod can't read your real balance: neither service shows it to a normal API key. Your real balance is on the service's dashboard.
advanced_stt.settings.balance.saved: Balance saved. The estimate counts down from here.
advanced_stt.settings.language.assemblya: Detects French and English, even mixed.
advanced_stt.settings.language.cartesia: English only. Will probably be removed: use AssemblyAI.
